title: VeloraOS 1.10.29 - Knowledge + Mobile Chat Cleanup
releaseNotes: Removes the Workspaces project editor, command runner and Git interface.
Keeps local Knowledge as a dedicated VeloraOS-themed private per-account feature.
Cleans up mobile Chat with a single plus button for Cosmic Reasoning, Lockdown, exports and model selection.
Desktop Chat retains its full controls while mobile uses a compact touch-friendly action sheet.
Preserves hardware-aware Coding, automatic web research and persistent Lockdown mode.
